race.comment: LATASSA (9) has the right recent profile to break through after successive placings, boxing on for third when last seen at Kilmore over 1612m. Bred to get over a trip, she should continue to improve and will get every chance from the inside gate. PARERA (5) is the main danger, easing from a metro Cranbourne third where he was beaten two and a half lengths and having been close at this venue two back; he is also new to the trip, but draws to tag LATASSA and try to out-tough her late. ENTICEMENT (11) is still learning and was well beaten behind LATASSA at Kilmore, yet her debut fifth at Ballarat was sound enough to keep her in calculations with natural improvement. JAKBE NIMBLE (4) lifted into second at Wangaratta last start, is third-up now, and has already placed at this distance which could be key against a few unexposed rivals.
